unit_now: Provinces San Pedro de Macorís, La Romana, La Altagracia, El Seibo, Hato Mayor, 2022 census
notes: Rating covers the only filled figure. now = San Pedro de Macorís 337,146 + La Romana 287,914 + La Altagracia 446,060 + El Seibo 99,169 + Hato Mayor 100,133 (2022 census, final). This equals Yuma + Higuamo minus Monte Plata in the census region table. Territory vs 1920: SPM province since 1907 = comunes San Pedro de Macorís and San José de los Llanos. Higüey (La Altagracia) was a común of Seibo. La Altagracia and La Romana became provinces in 1961 (La Romana split from La Altagracia). Hato Mayor split from El Seibo in 1992. So the 5 provinces match 1920 SPM + Seibo, as far as checked. Monte Plata is left out. c1900 empty: 1920 census figures for SPM and Seibo provinces not found online (only común El Jovero/Miches 1,692 is given). c1800 empty: no source found. unit_c1800: Gobierno de Veragua y Alanje (Veraguas + Chiriqui together; no separate Alanje/Chiriqui figure found)
unit_c1900: Provinces of Chiriqui + Bocas del Toro (the Comarca Ngabe-Bugle land was inside them, and partly inside Veraguas)
unit_now: Provinces of Chiriqui + Bocas del Toro + Comarca Ngabe-Bugle
notes: c1800 is a weak proxy: Silvestre (padron dated 1778 by McKay) gives only the joint Gobierno de Veragua y Alanje, 21081 almas (7954 Yndios, 11522 libres, 411 esclavos); it includes Veraguas, which is outside the region, so it overstates; unconquered Guaymi (Ngabe) and the Bocas del Toro coast were not counted. 1911: Chiriqui 63364 + Bocas del Toro 22732 (INEC Cuadro 9). 2023 census: Bocas del Toro 159228 + Chiriqui 471071 + Comarca Ngabe-Bugle 212084. The comarca (Ley 10 of 1997) was cut from Bocas del Toro, Chiriqui AND Veraguas (https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Comarca_Ngäbe-Buglé), so the 2023 sum includes a part that was in Veraguas in 1911 (not quantified).

unit_c1800: Jurisdictions of Tegucigalpa (alcaldia mayor, incl. Choluteca valley) + Olancho in the 1804 Anguiano report
unit_c1900: Departments of Choluteca + Valle + El Paraiso + Olancho
unit_now: Departments of Choluteca + Valle + El Paraiso + Olancho
notes: c1800 is DERIVED and a proxy: Newson (Mesoamerica 9, 1985, Cuadro 4, Anguiano 1804) gives indios and their share: Tegucigalpa 4842 = 12.7%, Olancho 1523 = 19.8%; totals 4842/0.127 = 38126 + 1523/0.198 = 7692 = 45818. The Tegucigalpa jurisdiction includes the Tegucigalpa mining district (now Francisco Morazan, outside the region), so this overstates; Juarros puts Xerez de la Choluteca in the partido of Tegucigalpa. Newson's shares do not add up exactly to her regional totals, so treat c1800 as approximate (may be off by a few percent). 1901: Choluteca 45340 + Valle 33450 + El Paraiso 39918 + Olancho 44496 (Valle split from Choluteca in 1893 and is listed separately). now = INE projection 2026 (Tomo 10): Choluteca 507492 + Valle 203100 + El Paraiso 540716 + Olancho 626467.

unit_c1800: Jurisdiction of Gracias a Dios in the 1804 Anguiano report (western Honduras: Gracias, Santa Rosa de los Llanos, etc.)
